decomposition_step: 1. Raw relational join rows (indiv_enrlmt_id x rcv_bnft_enrlmt_id x raw ppef_addr_2019 row)
methodological_explanation: Includes multiple suite/street rows in ppef_addr_2019 for the same group & ZIP5 (210,055 redundant suite/street rows removed in Step 3).

decomposition_step: 2. Deduplicated across multiple individual enrlmt_ids per NPI (npi x rcv_bnft_enrlmt_id x raw ppef_addr_2019 row)
methodological_explanation: Removes 3,136 duplicate rows caused by midwives holding >1 individual enrollment ID (I20...) linked to the same billing group.

decomposition_step: 3. Deduplicated street/suite rows within same billing group, city, state & ZIP5 (mysteryroster link rows: npi x indiv_enrlmt_id x rcv_bnft_enrlmt_id x city x state x zip5)
methodological_explanation: Exact 184,694 count reported by mysteryroster::attribute_enrollment_locations() after collapsing ppef_addr_2019 to unique (enrlmt_id, city, state, zip5).

decomposition_step: 4. Distinct clinician x billing organization x 5-digit ZIP5 (npi x rcv_bnft_enrlmt_id x zip5)
methodological_explanation: Collapses multiple city names within the same 5-digit ZIP5 and billing organization.

decomposition_step: 5. Distinct clinician x city x state x 5-digit ZIP5 across all billing groups (npi x city x state x zip5)
methodological_explanation: Collapses overlapping clinic sites shared across >1 billing organization for the same midwife.

decomposition_step: 6. Distinct clinician x 5-digit ZIP5 pairs across all billing groups (npi x zip5)
methodological_explanation: True distinct (midwife, 5-digit ZIP5) candidate practice locations (~30.0 unique ZIP5s per group-linked midwife; median 15).

decomposition_step: 7. Distinct clinician x state pairs across all billing groups (npi x state)
methodological_explanation: Mean 1.11 states per group-linked midwife (510 midwives linked to multi-state billing groups).

decomposition_step: 8. Distinct clinician x billing organization pairs (npi x rcv_bnft_enrlmt_id)
methodological_explanation: Mean 1.45 billing organizations (O20...) per group-linked midwife.
5,625 midwives have group-reassigned locations (plus 18 with direct-only and 8 with both = 5,643 linked midwives).

decomposition_step: 10. Distinct midwives with >=1 direct OR group-reassigned location (npi; Figure 2 Stage 2)
methodological_explanation: 95.69% (5,643 / 5,897) of 2019 PECOS-enrolled midwives have >=1 associated administrative address.

decomposition_step: 11. Out-of-state share among 184,694 city/state/ZIP-deduped group rows (state != 2019 NPPES state)
methodological_explanation: 9.32% of raw group rows lie outside the midwife's 2019 NPPES state due to interstate billing groups.

decomposition_step: 12. Out-of-state share among 168,917 distinct (npi, zip5) pairs (state != 2019 NPPES state)
methodological_explanation: 9.65% (16,148 / 168,917) of distinct (midwife, ZIP5) pairs lie outside the midwife's 2019 NPPES state.
